method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: A bar chart; weak casts; flat bands.
notes.fix: Higher relief, a 15 degree key, box ends at the left with raised rings.
A raking oblique with lit crowns and casts, a pool on the banded five.
Pull back so all twenty box ends are lit as round ends with the bands on them; both beams cast.

notes.problem: Mannequin at a different depth from the stands.
notes.fix: The person at the stand's base by the slips, side-lit, the cabin deleted.
Key from the upper left, behind the gate rail, stands spaced.
Turn the figure three-quarters away, rim-lit from the flood, a contact shadow.
Draw the six as a different surface off the floor, the pool only on the tread.

notes.problem: No subject at 432 px; the lit three barely brighter.
notes.fix: A real pool 25 L* above the grating, low rake so the dark panels cast and recede.

notes.problem: Grey noise strata; dot rig; thin string.
notes.fix: Near-black strata, a low rake so only the groove and string catch an edge, a lit mast silhouette.

notes.problem: One-material noise; dead bottom; dot rig.
notes.fix: Three strata materials, a pool along the lateral, crop the empty bottom.
Die pads, loom, grime, a mill-scale pipe with a hardband ring.

notes.problem: A rounded box lit head-on; no jaws; blurred column.
notes.fix: Jaws with die pads, the key at azimuth -60 elevation 26, grime, a sharp tool joint above.

notes.problem: Duplicates the cover; flat band; prism slips.
notes.fix: A low three-quarter at the rotary; remove the band's emissive term.

notes.problem: Repeats the cover at feed size.
notes.fix: A low three-quarter from the rotary, slips, box mouth and arm in one diagonal.

notes.problem: Rack in the bottom quarter; dead band.
notes.fix: Lower and push the camera so the ten banded joints fill the middle third.

notes.problem: The split reads as a stripe; plain pipe and posts.
notes.fix: Drop onto the rack's axis so the box ends face the lens as two blocks of ten.

notes.problem: Starfield window; lime vest; one console.
notes.fix: The floodlit floor through the glass; the vest in sun-worn safety yellow.
